Intro: Do you think you could help me out here? I can't move. I'm stuck.
It was raining when I walked here. Stepped through some mud, then some more mud, and now, I'm just stuck.
So I thought some food would give me the energy to lift up my feet. Yeah. A [DISH] or something would be great.
Success: Hrrgh… gah! One foot… in front of… the other! Why won't… the mud… come off?
Fail: It didn't work. And now there's mud all over. Why must there be so much…
Reject: Maybe. I didn't want to move anyway.
